text.description_html:
LCN 4111T Track Closer, LCN "Super Smoothee"

The LCN 4111T is a heavy duty, track arm closer designed for push side mounting on institutional and other high traffic interior doors. The 4111T closer is shipped with standard arm, standard track, track roller, standard plastic cover and self reaming and tapping screws.

This handed closer has passed 10,000,000 cycles in independant testing. UL and ULC listed for self-closing doors without hold-open. Fully adjustable spring rate, closing speed, latch speed and back check. Mounts on the push side of the door.

Also available: LCN 4111 with Parallel Mounting

Tested and certified under ANSI Standard A156.4, grade one.

Specifications and Features: of LCN 4111T Track Arm Door Closer

  • Adjustable Closing Speed
  • Adjustable Latching Speed
  • Adjustable Back Check
  • Cast Iron Housing
  • All Weather Fluid
  • Maximum Door Opening: 110º
  • Maximum Door Weight: 250 lbs
  • Maximum Door Size: 26" - 48" Interior
  • Handed
  • Mounts on Push Side of Door
  • Grade 1 (Highest Grade)
  • UL 10C Approved
  • Spring Size: Adjustable 1-4
  • Standard with Cover
  • 30 Year Warranty
  • ADA Compliant
  • Aluminum Finish
  • LCN 4111T Specifications (PDF).

*Important When selecting Door Hand for this door closer:
1. Stand on the Push Side of the door, facing the door.
2. If the "Pivot Hinge" is on your "Left", choose "Left Hand Door".
3. If the "Pivot Hinge" is on your "Right", choose "Right Hand Door".
